**Finding: compliant (preferred level).**

The Agreement imposes no non-compete or field-of-use restraint on Bluefly. § 14.16 (Freedom of Action) affirmatively states that "Each party is free to enter into similar agreements with others." The only Customer-side prohibitions found (§ 14.11 no resale of the Services, § 12.1 use of Base Components solely in connection with the Services, § 14.19 geographic scope of IBM's delivery) are licence-scope and service-delivery terms, not restrictive covenants on our business or purchasing freedom. No redline proposed.
